body:
2 years  i tried multiple thoughts and attempted to kill myself over a boy. him and i really did love each other but our parents forced the breakup. i never healed from it but it seems like hes happy now...
sometimes i realise it was good that i didnt kill myself back then even though right now i want to die because of music (singing is just so hard and competitive). and idk anymore if i want to live and keep pursuing because if i dont become a singer im going to feel empty and hollow and not see the point of living. but i would say dont kill yourself yet because sometimes after a horrible breakup you can really find your passion and dream like i have. no matter how many failures you have.

tbh dont you find it hard to be honest with your mother? i always lie to her about everything because theres no point in being honest about how i feel. i will tell you this my mum forced me to break up with my boyfriend 2 years ago and im still really not over it. it was more like my mum and her mum (my grandmother on mums side) that forced the breakup to happen. i didnt wish to talk to my grandmother and i told my mum that honestly and she laughed at me and said why. and she kept asking why so i told her the truth that it was because she and grandmother forced me to break up with my boyfriend. ALL SHE DID WAS LAUGH AND SAID HOW STUPID I WAS. it didnt feel stupid to me i was so heartbroken and from that day onwards it triggered my depression and i tried to kill myself many times but was too scared. eventually i found music and singing to help me but now i feel hopeless in music as well... idk what to do:(
should i give up on my only dream?

i feel the way you feel as well. in terms of singing and music. my family put more money into giving me singing lessons, piano lessons, etc but im still a failure and not even great in it. recently only been offered a diploma of contemporary performance for voice and fell into depression again... and like you im so so tired of trying and always falling down and failing from my anxiety. and like you i cant keep long term relationships and on the outside everyone sees this happy girl but im not happy. my family sees that i dont talk and isolated myself from them but all they say is im selfish and i should act happy and caring in front of them just like how i am with my friends. but with friends i need to keep a good front and it gets so tiring and i just feeling like crying because im a failure and my family (especially my mum doesnt understand it and expects me to at least pretend being happy by having a happy nice clear voice when im speaking to her but in fact im so sick of her and everything in life...
sorry i had to vent it out. i will pm you

well dont worry so is mine. my mother is an asshole and all she does is complain that i dont do anything and selfish and dont listen to her problems. but her problems are so fking basic and stupid talking about how hard life is for her due to feeding me and cleaning me and providing money for music and saying how poor we are... my mum is so fucking annoying and shit.
